Bagaimana setelahnya? Atmosfer canggung sempat merayap di antara kalian selama beberapa menit.

Keheningan terasa begitu pekat saat deru napas kalian berangsur normal. Namun, rasa canggung itu tidak bertahan lama ketika Jake menarik selimut untuk menutupi tubuh kalian, lalu membawamu kembali ke dalam dekapan hangatnya.

"Yn?" panggil Jake, suaranya terdengar serak dan berat.

"Iya, Mas Jake..." sahutmu pelan. 

Kamu tidak bergerak menjauh. Malahan, kamu makin menenggelamkan wajahmu, memeluk tubuh atletisnya dan bersandar nyaman pada dada bidang mantan suamimu itu. 

Detak jantungnya yang terdengar di bawah telingamu entah kenapa memberikan rasa aman yang sudah lama hilang.

"Kalau dipikir-pikir... dulu alasan kita bercerai sebenarnya kekanak-kanakan banget, ya?" Jake mengembuskan napas pendek, jemarinya bergerak lembut membelai dan merapikan rambut panjangmu yang sedikit berantakan.

Kamu terdiam sejenak, meresapi kalimatnya sebelum akhirnya mendongak untuk menatap rahang tegasnya. "Aku juga sering berpikir kayak gitu, Mas," ujarmu lirih. "Dulu, kita sama-sama egois. Sama-sama belum dewasa dalam menghadapi masalah."

Jake menunduk, menatapmu dengan seulas senyum tipis. Ia mengecup keningmu lama, menyalurkan seluruh perasaan yang tak sempat terucap lewat kata-kata.

"Kamu... di sini aja malam ini, ya? Jangan ke atas. Aku masih kangen," pinta Jake dengan suara yang terdengar seperti sebuah bisikan candu.

Kamu menggigit bibir, sempat ragu sejenak. "Jayden gimana, Mas? Takutnya dia nyariin aku pas kebangun nanti."

"Nanti aku cek Jayden ke atas," potong Jake menenangkan, sembari menepuk-nepuk bahumu pelan. "Dia udah hampir lima tahun. Lagipula, enggak ada salahnya kan kita mulai ajari dia tidur sendiri pelan-pelan?"

Mendengar penjelasannya yang masuk akal, kekhawatiranmu perlahan menguap. Kamu mengangguk pelan, kemudian makin mengeratkan pelukanmu pada tubuh Jake, menyerap kehangatan yang ditawarkannya di tengah dinginnya angin pantai yang menyusup lewat celah jendela.

Suasana kembali hening selama beberapa saat, sampai tiba-tiba kamu merasakan kecupan-kecupan kecil Jake mendarat di puncak kepalamu, lalu turun ke pelipis, dan berhenti tepat di pipimu.

"Mau lagi?" tanyanya tiba-tiba.

Kamu mengerutkan alis, pura-pura bingung meski jantungmu kembali berdegup kencang. "Apanya, Mas Jake?"

Jake terkekeh pelan, getaran di dadanya terasa jelas di pipimu. Ia menatapmu dengan binar mata menggoda. "Jangan pura-pura enggak ngerti, sayang."

Wajahmu seketika memanas. Kamu memukul dadanya pelan. "Enggak! Takut Jayden kebangun nanti!" Tolak mu, mencoba mencari alasan aman.

Bukannya mundur, Jake justru makin mengeratkan pelukannya hingga tubuh kalian tak menyisakan jarak sama sekali. Senyum nakal terbit di bibirnya. "Dia enggak bakal kebangun, kok..." bisik Jake tepat di telingamu, membuat bulu kudukmu meremang. "...asalkan kamu enggak teriak-teriak keenakan, Yn."

"Mas, ih!" Pipi yang sudah memerah kini makin terasa terbakar. Karena terlampau salah tingkah dan gemas, kamu mendaratkan satu cubitan kuat di lengan atas Jake.

"Awwww! Sakit banget, sayang, cubitan kamu," ringis Jake dramatis, walau sedetik kemudian ia justru tertawa renyah, mengunci tubuhmu dalam dekapannya agar kamu tidak bisa melayangkan cubitan kedua.

Sisa-sisa kecanggungan di antara kalian menguap sepenuhnya, digantikan oleh tawa kecil dan kehangatan masa lalu yang perlahan-lahan mulai bersemi kembali.

Kasus tragis menimpa seorang asisten rumah tangga (ART) berinisial RR (26) di Perumahan Kota Wisata, Cileungsi, Bogor. Korban m3n1ngg4l dunia setelah diduga d14n14y4 oleh tiga orang yang merupakan rekan kerjanya sendiri

​Polisi mengungkapkan bahwa motif di balik aksi k3j4m ini ternyata sepele, yaitu dipicu oleh hilangnya charger jam tangan milik majikan mereka yang tidak kunjung ditemukan.

​Kronologi Kejadian
​Peristiwa kelam ini bermula pada Rabu (27/5). Saat itu, pemilik rumah sedang berada di luar kota. Ketiga pelaku menginterogasi korban soal charger yang hilang, namun korban mengaku memang tidak tahu di mana barang tersebut.

​Kesal karena pencarian tidak membuahkan hasil, situasi mulai memanas:
✅​Ancaman Pelaku: Salah satu pelaku sempat mengancam akan menyiram korban dengan air panas jika tidak mengaku.
✅​Tindakan K3j4m: Ancaman itu bukan gertakan sambal. Sekitar pukul 15.00 WIB, ketiga pelaku membawa korban ke kamar mandi dan secara bergantian menyiram tubuh korban dengan air panas.
✅​Ditelantarkan: Korban kemudian ditinggalkan begitu saja dalam kondisi kulit melepuh, lalu dibawa ke kamar ART dan hanya diberi penanganan seadanya.

​Karena luka yang p4r4h dan tidak mendapat pengobatan layak, kondisi korban terus memburuk. Pada Sabtu (30/5) sekitar pukul 19.30 WIB, korban ditemukan sudah m3n1ngg4l dunia di dalam kamarnya.

​Penyelidikan Polisi
​Setelah mendapat laporan, pihak Kepolisian Sektor Cileungsi langsung bergerak cepat mendatangi lokasi untuk melakukan olah tempat kejadian perkara (TKP).

​"Tim langsung melakukan olah TKP dan mengamankan sejumlah barang bukti, di antaranya ember, gayung, dan obat nyamuk semprot," kata Kapolsek Cileungsi, Kompol Edison, Senin (1/6/2026)

​Saat ini, polisi masih terus melakukan penyidikan lebih mendalam untuk mengungkap seluruh fakta dan memastikan para pelaku mendapat hukuman yang setimpal atas perbuatan k3j4m mereka.

Alun-alun di depan kuil telah dipadati oleh kerumunan orang yang bersiap untuk mengiringi tandu suci Mazu, yang dijuluki mobil sport merah muda, dalam perjalanan selama 8 hari 7 malam.

Keberangkatan dijadwalkan akan berlangsung pada jam antara pukul 23:00 hingga 01:00 pada tanggal 12 April 2026 malam. Tingginya jumlah pendaftar membuat banyak peziarah khawatir tidak akan kebagian tiket kereta atau bahkan tidak bisa mendekati area kuil jika datang terlalu mepet. Mengantisipasi hal ini, banyak dari mereka yang datang lebih awal, membawa tenda dan perlengkapan seadanya, berencana untuk berkemah di lahan-lahan kosong di sekitar kuil.

Salah satu hal yang paling dinanti-nantikan oleh para peziarah tahun ini adalah potensi langka untuk menyaksikan pertemuan antara dua Dewi Mazu yang paling dihormati, yakni Dewi Mazu Baishatun dan Dewi Mazu Dajia, yang rute ziarahnya berpotensi bersinggungan. Selain itu, keunikan Baishatun yang mengeluarkan tiga sosok Dewi Mazu secara bersamaan juga menjadi daya tarik tersendiri.  

"Tentu saja saya sangat menantikan pertemuan dua Mazu," ujar seorang peziarah, menyuarakan harapan banyak orang.

Fenomena modern pun turut mewarnai tradisi kuno ini. Di dunia maya, para warganet dan peziarah berpengalaman saling berbagi panduan strategi untuk para pendatang baru. Informasi mengenai lokasi-lokasi yang ideal untuk mendirikan tenda, seperti di tanggul belakang kuil atau di area luas Pabrik Pariwisata Garam Taiyen, dibagikan secara luas.

Panduan ini juga mencakup analisis rute keberangkatan Mazu berdasarkan pola beberapa tahun terakhir, yang umumnya bergerak ke selatan melalui Provincial Highway 1 menuju arah Dajia.

Meskipun ada panduan dan prediksi, elemen yang paling memikat dari prosesi ini adalah rutenya yang tidak tetap dan sepenuhnya bergantung pada "kehendak" sang Dewi.

The federal government’s proposal to withdraw fuel subsidies for the wealthy has caused a stir, leading Transport Minister Anthony Loke to clarify that the matter is still under study and no final decision has been reached.

Loke emphasised that Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s remarks on May 10 were merely a response to media questions rather than a policy announcement.

“Anwar responded to a media question on whether (fuel subsidies for) the T20 would be cut, and he only said the government is still studying it,” he said.

Weconomix team gets into the weeds of the Budi Madani RON95 targeted subsidy distribution that aims to eliminate access to the subsidy for non-Malaysians. The program allocates 300L per Malaysian who has their Identity Card and valid Malaysian Driver’s License and is aged 16 and above. WE discuss what the 300 Litre means for Malaysian’s–from, whether 300L  per-month is enough, how it will affect our petrol pumping culture, the savings it will provide to the National budget to what we can look forward to from money earned not spending on blanket RON95 subsidy.

Dasar yang baik, cakap terus terang. Kalau nak buat BUDI95 masa pilihan raya, sebut saja. Jangan depan cakap lain, belakang buat lain, umum pun lain.

Perdana Menteri sendiri pernah puji penyasaran subsidi elektrik sebagai contoh terbaik, yang kaya bayar lebih, yang susah dilindungi. Tapi bila kena kecam, tiba-tiba kata “kita belajar dari kesilapan elektrik”. Jadi adakah penyasaran subsidi elektrik satu kesilapan dan segala tindakan susulan selepas itu perlu ditukar sekarang?

Dari sudut ekonomi, BUDI95 bukan penyasaran semula, tapi had harga menyeluruh. Bunyi dia lebih kepada pendekatan populis.

Pasaran dan penganalisis nampak ini sebagai tanda flip-flop. Dulu janji nak teruskan reform walau pahit, sekarang ubah bila hampir PRU. Konsistensi dasar itu yang bina kepercayaan. Kalau kerajaan serius, teruskan prinsip. Kalau nak ambil jalan populis, sebut saja dengan jujur, biar rakyat nilai sendiri.

Malaysia has long relied on fuel subsidies to maintain low petrol prices through mechanisms like the Automatic Pricing Mechanism (APM), supported by its status as a net energy exporter and strong dividends from Petronas. Over decades, policies evolved from blanket subsidies to targeted systems such as BUDI95, especially after reforms under Najib Razak. However, with global crude oil prices surging due to geopolitical tensions, the gap between subsidised and market fuel prices is widening, placing significant strain on Malaysia’s fiscal position.
In this video, we break down what happens if Malaysia removes the RON95 subsidy and how it directly impacts Malaysians’ cost of living, from petrol and food prices to transport, salaries, and daily expenses. You’ll understand how rising subsidy costs affect the national budget, inflation, and economic stability, and why policies like BUDI95 are being adjusted. Most importantly, we explore how these changes could reshape household spending, savings like EPF, and overall financial resilience for Malaysians.

⛽💬 Here’s what you need to know about Budi95:

→ All Malaysians regardless of income can enjoy the new RM1.99/litre RON95 price starting 30 Sept. Users must have a MyKad with a functioning chip and an active driving licence.

→ To refuel, users only need to insert their MyKad at the pump or present it at the counter. Then, pay as usual.

→ Alternatively, users can refuel with apps like Setel, CaltexGo and Touch n’ Go, which only require one-time MyKad verification.  

→ Each user has a monthly limit of 300 litres of subsidised RON95.

→ E-hailing and p-hailing drivers can apply for a higher subsidised RON95 quota with supporting documents from their companies.

→ Government will monitor and flag abnormal refueling patterns. This is to prevent people from abusing the system by topping up repeatedly in a short time span and reselling fuel.

→ JPN is offering free replacements of damaged MyKad chips from 23 Sept-7 Oct. 

→ JPJ is extending weekend operating hours to 8.30am-4.30pm to handle driving licence and related services for the period 27 Sept-26 Oct.

→ RON95 will be sold at a subsidised price of RM2.05 per litre for eligible commercial vehicles and public transport vehicles including taxis, ambulances, school buses and food catering vans. Non-Malaysians and ineligible individuals will pay the unsubsidised market rate, to be determined at the end of September.

→ Foreign-registered vehicles cannot purchase RON95 and can only refuel with RON97.

→ Government expects to save between RM2.5 billion to RM4 billion annually under Budi95, depending on crude oil prices.

Kendaraan mu masih kredit tapi hilang dicuri?

Dalam hukum perikatan, jika objek perjanjian berupa barang tertentu itu musnah, hilang, atau tidak dapat diperdagangkan lagi  karena keadaan memaksa (overmacht) dan bukan disebabkan kesalahan debitur, maka kewajiban debitur untuk memenuhi prestasinya hapus.

Oleh karena itu, apabila kendaraan yang masih dalam status kredit hilang karena pencurian dan terbukti bukan akibat kelalaian peminjam, maka debitur tidak lagi berkewajiban meneruskan pembayaran cicilan, karena prestasi menjadi mustahil dipenuhi oleh sebab di luar kekuasaan debitur.

Ini sejalan dengan Pasal 1444 KUHPerdata yang menyatakan bahwa jika barang tertentu musnah di luar kesalahan debitur, maka perikatannya hapus dan para pihak kembali pada keadaan semula (restitutio in integrum).

Mandat Rakyat 1955 : Detik Penubuhan Kabinet Pertama Tanah Melayu

Kemenangan besar Parti Perikatan dalam Pilihanraya Persekutuan pertama pada 27 Julai 1955 adalah isyarat jelas bahawa rakyat Tanah Melayu telah bersedia untuk menentukan halatuju mereka sendiri. 

Dalam pilihan raya bersejarah itu, gabungan parti yang dianggotai oleh United Malay National Organisation (UMNO), Malayan Chinese Association (MCA), dan Malayan Indian Congress (MIC) telah meraih kemenangan luar biasa, memenangi 51 daripada 52 kerusi yang dipertandingkan.

Berikutan mandat padu daripada rakyat, YTM Tunku Abdul Rahman Putra, selaku pemimpin Parti Perikatan, telah memikul tanggungjawab besar untuk membentuk kerajaan. Pada 1 Ogos 1955, Tunku Abdul Rahman telah mengetuai proses pembentukan Kabinet pertama Persekutuan Tanah Melayu, satu langkah gergasi ke arah berkerajaan sendiri.

Barisan Kabinet sulung ini mencerminkan semangat permuafakatan Perikatan, dianggotai oleh 10 orang Menteri, 2 Timbalan Menteri, dan 3 Penolong Menteri yang terdiri daripada pemimpin-pemimpin kanan ketiga-tiga parti komponen. Sejajar dengan peranan barunya mengetuai jemaah menteri ini, YTM Tunku Abdul Rahman telah dilantik sebagai Ketua Menteri Tanah Melayu yang pertama.

Proses peralihan kuasa ini diiktiraf secara rasmi apabila Pesuruhjaya Tinggi British, Sir Donald MacGillivray, membuat pengumuman senarai anggota Kabinet di King’s House pada 4 Ogos 1955. Pembentukan ini juga telah mendapat perkenan penuh daripada Raja-raja Melayu, menandakan restu institusi tradisional terhadap hala tuju baharu negara.

Pada 9 Ogos 1955, majlis angkat sumpah diadakan dengan penuh hormat, disaksikan oleh Ketua Hakim, Mr. Pretheroe. Walaupun kemerdekaan penuh masih berbaki dua tahun lagi, penubuhan Kabinet pertama Persekutuan Tanah Melayu ini adalah detik yang paling penting. 

Ia menjadi asas dan tapak latihan pentadbiran, membuktikan keupayaan pemimpin tempatan untuk mentadbir negara, dan merupakan langkah kritikal yang memuluskan jalan menuju kemerdekaan penuh pada 31 Ogos 1957.

📚Menurut Pasal 1381 KUH Perdata, ada 10 cara perikatan hapus, yaitu: pembayaran, penawaran pembayaran tunai diikuti penitipan, pembaruan utang, perjumpaan utang, percampuran utang, pembebasan utang, musnahnya barang terutang, pembatalan perjanjian, berlakunya syarat batal, dan daluwarsa.

✅️Pembayaran:
Adalah pemenuhan prestasi oleh debitur kepada kreditur, baik berupa penyerahan uang, barang, atau jasa. 
✅️Penawaran Pembayaran Tunai diikuti Penitipan:
Jika kreditur menolak pembayaran yang ditawarkan oleh debitur, debitur dapat menitipkan pembayaran tersebut ke pengadilan. 
✅️Pembaruan Utang (Novasi):
Terjadi ketika suatu perikatan lama dihapuskan dan diganti dengan perikatan baru. 
✅️Perjumpaan Utang (Kompensasi):
Penghapusan utang piutang antara dua pihak yang saling berutang, dimana utang tersebut dapat diperhitungkan. 
✅️Percampuran Utang (Konfusio):
Terjadi ketika kedudukan kreditur dan debitur bersatu pada satu orang. 
✅️Pembebasan Utang:
Kreditur secara sukarela membebaskan debitur dari kewajiban membayar utang. 
✅️Musnahnya Barang Terutang:
Jika barang yang menjadi objek perikatan musnah tanpa kesalahan debitur, perikatan tersebut hapus. 
✅️Pembatalan Perjanjian:
Perjanjian yang cacat hukum (misalnya, dibuat oleh orang yang belum dewasa) dapat dibatalkan. 
✅️Berlakunya Syarat Batal:
Perjanjian yang mengandung syarat batal, jika syarat tersebut terpenuhi, akan menyebabkan perjanjian berakhir. 
✅️Daluwarsa:
Hapusnya hak untuk menuntut karena lewatnya waktu yang ditentukan oleh undang-undang.

⚖️ Apa Perbedaan antara Perikatan dan Perjanjian? 🤔
Dalam hukum perdata, perikatan dan perjanjian sering dianggap sama, padahal keduanya memiliki perbedaan mendasar!

📌 🔹 Perikatan (Verbintenis)
✅ Hubungan hukum antara dua pihak atau lebih, di mana satu pihak berhak menuntut sesuatu dari pihak lain.
✅ Sumbernya bisa dari hukum (misalnya kewajiban membayar pajak) atau perjanjian.
✅ Bersifat lebih luas dibanding perjanjian.

📌 🔹 Perjanjian (Overeenkomst)
✅ Kesepakatan antara dua pihak atau lebih untuk menciptakan, mengubah, atau mengakhiri hak dan kewajiban.
✅ Merupakan salah satu sumber perikatan (diatur dalam Pasal 1313 KUH Perdata).
✅ Hanya muncul jika ada kesepakatan antara para pihak.

📢 Kesimpulan:
Perikatan adalah hubungan hukum secara umum, sedangkan perjanjian adalah salah satu cara untuk menciptakan perikatan. Jadi, setiap perjanjian menciptakan perikatan, tetapi tidak semua perikatan berasal dari perjanjian!

Text:
Seorang terapis spa di Surabaya bernama Nur Hasannah Prasetya didakwa menguras uang pelanggan hingga Rp 1,285 miliar. Uang itu diduga dipakai untuk hidup mewah bersama rekannya yang kini berstatus buron.

Dalam sidang di PN Surabaya, jaksa mengungkap Nur melakukan aksinya bersama Putriana Kusuma Wardani (DPO). Keduanya disebut mengenal korban, Tonny Soegiono, saat Nur bekerja di Spa Superior.

Nur diduga memanfaatkan kepercayaan korban yang kerap menitipkan ponsel saat ke toilet. Ia juga disebut sudah mengetahui PIN ATM korban setelah mengintip saat penarikan uang.

Aksi transfer uang itu dilakukan berulang kali sejak Agustus hingga September 2024. Total ada 33 transaksi keluar dari rekening korban ke rekening Nur, mulai Rp 5 juta hingga Rp 50 juta per transaksi.

Korban baru menyadari rekeningnya terkuras setelah mencetak mutasi rekening pada 25 September 2024. Uang hasil kejahatan itu disebut dipakai untuk menginap di Hotel Shangri-La hingga membeli perhiasan.

Atas perbuatannya, Nur didakwa dengan pasal pencurian yang dilakukan bersama-sama dan berlanjut. Sementara rekannya masih dalam pencarian polisi.

Lettre ouverte : Non aux promesses irréalistes

On ne reconstruit pas un pays en 5 ans après un demi-siècle de mauvais choix.

Mesdames, Messieurs les politiques,

Les Français ne sont pas des enfants. Ils ne croient plus aux contes de fées politiques où, d’un coup de baguette magique, un programme électoral efface cinquante années d’inaction, de renoncements et de mauvaises décisions accumulées.

Nous savons tous, au fond de nous, ce que signifie gouverner un pays. Nous savons qu’un État qui a repoussé pendant des décennies les réformes nécessaires sur les retraites, l’école, la dette, l’immigration, la compétitivité, la justice, l’énergie ne se redressera pas en cinq ans. Pas en une législature. Pas par la seule vertu d’un discours enflammé ou d’une série de promesses chiffrées à la va-vite.

Ceux qui nous promettent le miracle en 2027, ou même en 2030, nous prennent pour des naïfs. Ils nous insultent par leur démagogie. Car le redressement d’une nation exige du temps, de la constance, du courage et surtout de la vérité. 

La vérité, c’est que :

•  On ne ramène pas la dette publique sous les 100 % du PIB en une mandature sans choix douloureux.

•  On ne restaure pas l’autorité de l’État et l’intégration républicaine après des décennies de laxisme en quelques lois cosmétiques.

•  On ne redonne pas à l’école française son excellence passée sans remettre en cause des dogmes pédagogiques intouchables depuis quarante ans.

•  On ne relance l’industrie et la compétitivité sans accepter de travailler plus, de simplifier drastiquement et de baisser certaines charges.

Les Français l’ont compris. Ils sont adultes. Ils savent distinguer l’énergie du changement réel de l’agitation médiatique. Ils savent qu’un pays n’est pas une start-up qu’on pivote en six mois. C’est une grande et vieille nation avec son histoire, ses rigidités, ses acquis sociaux, ses corporatismes et ses fractures. La transformer exige de la persévérance sur dix, quinze ou vingt ans.

Nous en avons assez des calendriers enchantés et des lendemains qui chantent. Assez des promesses qui finissent en impôts supplémentaires, en déficits creusés et en désillusions collectives. Nous demandons de la sincérité : dites-nous la vérité sur l’ampleur de l’effort, sur la durée nécessaire, sur les sacrifices exigés. 

Respectez-nous assez pour nous traiter en citoyens responsables et non en électeurs à flatter.

La France ne se relèvera pas par des incantations. Elle se relèvera par des décisions prises, assumées et maintenues dans le temps, même quand elles seront impopulaires. Ceux qui n’ont pas le courage de le dire haut et fort n’ont pas vocation à nous gouverner.

Les Français sont prêts à l’effort, à condition qu’on arrête de leur mentir sur sa durée et son ampleur.

Le redressement exigera des choix difficiles et des sacrifices. Nous sommes prêts à les consentir. (Des millions j’en suis certain) Nous sommes prêts à travailler plus, à accepter des réformes courageuses, à faire des efforts sur le pouvoir d’achat, les retraites, les dépenses publiques et la compétitivité.

Mais à une condition claire : c’est du donnant-donnant.

Si les Français doivent se sacrifier, l’État doit se sacrifier aussi.

Il est temps de grandir collectivement.

Vive la France éternelle.

Kebangkitan Islam dan Peranan Umat dalam Masyarakat Majmuk

Sempena Majlis Hari Raya Aidilfitri PAS Pusat pada hari ini, YB Tan Sri Dato’ Seri Tuan Guru Haji Abdul Hadi Awang (TGHH), Presiden PAS telah menyampaikan sebuah ucapan yang padat dan berisi, menyentuh persoalan pokok tentang kebangkitan semula Islam sebagai sebuah sistem hidup yang menyeluruh.

Ucapan ini bukan sekadar perutusan perayaan, tetapi sebuah muhasabah strategik terhadap kedudukan umat Islam hari ini dan tanggungjawab yang perlu dipikul untuk membina masa depan yang lebih teguh.

1. Amanah dan Keadilan: Tiang Seri Kepimpinan

TGHH membuka ucapannya dengan merujuk kepada ayat al-Quran berkaitan konsep amanah iaitu kewajipan menyampaikan hak kepada yang berhak dan memerintah dengan penuh keadilan. 

Bagi TGHH, prinsip ini bukan sekadar retorik agama; ia adalah asas mutlak kepada seluruh bangunan kepimpinan Islam. Beliau menegaskan bahawa keruntuhan tamadun umat bermula apabila pemimpin mula mengkhianati amanah yang diletakkan di bahu mereka. Mesej ini jelas bahawa tanpa amanah, tiada kepimpinan yang sah, dan tanpa keadilan, tiada kestabilan yang berkekalan.

2. Tiga Punca Kejatuhan Kuasa Islam

Dalam nada yang tegas namun penuh hikmah, TGHH mengenal pasti tiga golongan utama yang bertanggungjawab terhadap kejatuhan kuasa-kuasa besar Islam sepanjang sejarah. 

Pertama, pemimpin negara yang lalai dan terlena dengan kemewahan sehingga mengabaikan tanggungjawab mereka terhadap rakyat dan agama. 

Kedua, golongan ulama yang lemah, bukan dari sudut ilmu semata-mata, tetapi dari sudut keberanian dan keupayaan untuk mengemukakan penyelesaian Islam secara praktikal kepada masyarakat. 

Ketiga, umat Islam sendiri yang jahil terhadap agama mereka, sehingga tidak mampu membezakan antara Islam yang sebenar dengan tafsiran yang menyimpang.

Ketiga-tiga faktor ini, menurut TGHH, saling berkait dan saling menguatkan antara satu sama lain. Apabila pemimpin lalai, ulama lemah, dan umat jahil, maka runtuhlah kuasa Islam di hadapan kuasa-kuasa lain seperti Rom dan Parsi pada zaman silam.

3. Cahaya Islam Tidak Pernah Padam

Namun, ucapan TGHH bukan bernada pesimis. Sebaliknya, beliau menegaskan satu keyakinan yang teguh bahawa ilmu Islam tidak akan pernah padam, kerana Allah SWT sendiri yang menjaganya. 

TGHH menyebut bahawa dalam al-Quran, Allah akan menggantikan sesuatu kaum dengan kaum yang lain untuk memperjuangkan Islam. Dalam setiap zaman, akan sentiasa wujud golongan yang bangkit mempertahankan kebenaran. Tidak ada sesuatu pun yang mampu menghalang tujuan yang telah Allah tetapkan. Ini adalah peringatan bahawa walaupun musuh-musuh Islam berusaha melemahkan umat, kekuatan Islam yang hakiki terletak pada janji Allah yang pasti.

4. Islam: Satu Sistem Hidup yang Menyeluruh

Salah satu teras terpenting dalam ucapan TGHH ialah penegasannya bahawa Islam bukan sekadar agama ritual. Islam adalah sebuah nizham — satu sistem cara hidup yang lengkap dan menyeluruh, merangkumi seluruh aspek kehidupan manusia, malah turut menggariskan adab dan tatacara berkelakuan terhadap makhluk lain. 

Apabila Islam dilaksanakan dengan betul dalam sesebuah negara, hasilnya bukan paksaan, tetapi tarikan. Manusia dari pelbagai latar belakang akan tertarik dan memeluk Islam kerana menyaksikan keindahan pelaksanaannya secara langsung. Inilah kekuatan dakwah yang sebenar, bukan melalui kata-kata semata, tetapi melalui teladan hidup yang nyata.

5. Malaysia: Model Masyarakat Majmuk Islam

Bahagian ucapan yang paling signifikan dari sudut strategik ialah apabila TGHH memilih Malaysia sebagai contoh terbaik untuk membuktikan bahawa Islam boleh dilaksanakan dengan betul dalam masyarakat pelbagai kaum dan agama. 

Bagi TGHH, kepelbagaian Malaysia bukan halangan, tetapi peluang besar. Jika Malaysia berjaya menunjukkan model pelaksanaan Islam yang adil, inklusif, dan berkesan, maka negara ini berpotensi menjadi rujukan dunia tentang bagaimana Islam diterapkan secara praktikal dalam masyarakat majmuk moden.

Ini adalah satu visi yang besar, tetapi bukan mustahil. TGHH melihat Malaysia sebagai medan ujian dan medan pembuktian serentak — satu pentas di mana keunggulan Islam sebagai sistem hidup boleh dipertontonkan kepada dunia.

6. Tiga Tuntutan Tindakan kepada Umat

Ucapan TGHH bukan sekadar analisis, ia adalah seruan bertindak. Tiga tuntutan jelas terpancar daripada keseluruhan ucapan beliau. Umat Islam perlu mengukuhkan ilmu agama mereka dan berhenti bersikap jahil terhadap Islam sebagai sistem hidup yang menyeluruh, bukan sekadar ibadah ritual. 

Sebagai umat, kita juga bertanggungjawab menuntut akauntabiliti daripada pemimpin dan tidak berdiam diri apabila amanah diabaikan. 

Akhir sekali, tanggungjawab untuk menjadikan Malaysia sebagai contoh pelaksanaan Islam yang terbaik bermula dari persekitaran terdekat kita, dengan mempraktikkan nilai-nilai Islam secara nyata dalam kehidupan seharian bersama masyarakat pelbagai kaum.

Pas mulai berdiri pada akhir tahun 1992 dengan formasi awal Bambang (gitar), Trisno (bas), Richard Mutter (drum), dan Yukie (vokal). Perjalanan karir dari panggung ke panggung walau pernah harus pinjam alat ke orang dan dibayar Rp. 25.000,00 sekali manggung tidak menjadikan surutnya harapan untuk maju.

Hal ini dibuktikan dengan pembuatan album indie label "4 Through The Sap" yang bermodalkan tabungan dan donasi simpatisan serta impian. Impian pun terwujud setelah 2500 kaset laku lewat sistem distribusi titipan di beberapa radio di Bandung dan Jakarta, toko-toko kaset dan membengkak sampai lebih dari 10.000 copy.
Sebuah terobosan yang mengharukan setelah demo Pas ditolak oleh beberapa Major Label menghasilkan suatu fenomena baru dalam pembuatan sebuah album rekaman yang selama ini didominasi oleh perusahaan-perusahaan rekaman besar. Sampai sekarang proses rekaman indie label terus berjalan dan semakin menjamur di berbagai kota di Indonesia.

PT. Aquarius Musikindo yang begitu jeli melihat potensi ini, mengkontrak Pas pada album "In(no)sensation", "IndieVduality", "Psycho I.D.", "Ketika...", "PAS 2.0", "Stairway to Seventh", "The BeAst of PAS", dan "Romantic, Lies, And Bleeding"

Richard Mutter (drummer) mengundurkan diri dari Pas setelah tour album Psycho I.D. berakhir. Penggarapan album "Ketika..." tanpa Richard tidak menjadikan Pas berhenti untuk terus berkreasi dalam blantika musik Indonesia. Hal ini terbukti dengan dirilisnya album 2.0 pada 2003. Posisi Richard Mutter sebagai drummer telah digantikan oleh Sandy Andarusman (Mantan U'Camp) yang resmi pada album ke enam Pas sebagai drummer tetap setelah mendampingi Pas selama pembuatan album Ketika... sampai sekarang.

In this video, the PN junction diode has been explained. And the working of this PN junction diode under forward and reverse bias has been explained. 

By watching this video, you will learn the following topics:

0:16 What is PN Junction Diode

1:48 The depletion region in the PN junction Diode

3:50 Unbiased PN Junction Diode

7:00 Forward-Biased PN Junction 

9:46 Reverse Biased PN Junction

What is PN Junction Diode:

When the P-type and N-type semiconductors are grown on the same crystal then the junction is formed where this P-type and N-type region meets. And this junction is known as the PN Junction. And the entire structure acts as a diode. 

The Depletion Region in PN Junction:

In PN junction diode, when p-type and n-type regions are joined together then electrons from the n-side recombines with the holes near the junction. And in this process, they create the positive and negative ions nears the junction. Hence, the region near the junction only contains positive and the negative ions. And being depleted from the free charge region, this region near the junction is knowns as the Depletion region.

The Unbiased PN Junction:
In the PN junction, the positive and the negative ions near the junction creates an electric field (Also knowns as the built-in electric field). This electric field prevents the majority carriers on both p-type and n-type region from diffusing through the depletion region. 
So, the depletion region creates a barrier potential or built-in potential for majority carriers. 
For, silicon this built-in potential is 0.7V and for germanium, it is 0.3V. 
But due to this electric field, the minority carriers near the junction gets attracted towards the junction and swapped across the depletion region. 
But under no biasing, the flow of minority charge carrier (due to the built-in electric field) and flow of majority carrier (due to diffusion) balances each other and net current in the circuit is zero.

The forward biased PN junction :

In forward biasing, the p-type terminal is connected to the positive terminal of the battery. While the n-type is connected to the negative terminal of the battery. 

And as we increase the external biasing voltage, the width of the depletion region reduces. So, the resistance offered by the depletion region (to majority carrier reduces).
And once the applied voltage is more than the built-in potential, the majority carriers are able to cross this depletion region barrier. 
So, under the forward bias condition, the current flows due to majority carriers. And the direction of the current is from p to n side. (Electrons moves from n-side to p-side and holes move from p-side to n-side)

The reversed biased PN Junction:

Under, reverse biased PN Junction, the p-side is connected to the negative terminal of the battery and n-side is connected to the positive terminal of the battery. 
And as the reverse bias voltage increases, the width of the depletion region also increases. So, the resistance offered by the depletion region also increases. 
But in the reverse bias condition, we get a flow of current due to minority carriers. Due to the strong electric field, the electrons get swapped from p-side to n-side and holes get swapped from n-side to p-side. So, in the reverse biased condition, we get a little flow of current due to minority carriers and the current flows from n-side to p-side. (In the reverse direction than the forward biased condition )
And that's why this current is known as the reverse saturation current. 

This video will be helpful to all students of science and engineering in understanding the PN junction and how it works under forward and reverse biased condition.

Kenneth MacMillan’s powerful telling of Manon (Sarah Lamb) and Des Grieux’s (Vadim Muntagirov) tragic love is a masterpiece of modern ballet, set to music by Massenet. Subscribe to our channel and find out more at https://www.roh.org.uk/productions/ma...

Kenneth MacMillan’s source for Manon was the 18th-century French novel by Abbé Prévost, already adapted for opera by Massenet and Puccini. Renowned dance musician Leighton Lucas and his assistant Hilda Gaunt provided a score drawn from across Massenet’s music, including his famous yearning Elégie as the theme for the lovers. The premiere was given on 7 March 1974, with the lead roles of Manon and Des Grieux danced by Antoinette Sibley and Anthony Dowell. The ballet quickly became a staple of The Royal Ballet’s repertory, and a touchstone of adult, dramatic dance.

MacMillan found new sympathy with the capricious Manon and her struggle to escape poverty. Designs by his regular collaborator Nicholas Georgiadis reflect this, depicting a world of lavish splendour polluted by miserable destitution. MacMillan’s spectacular ensemble scenes for the whole Company create vivid, complex portraits of the distinct societies of Paris and New Orleans. But it is Manon and Des Grieux’s impassioned pas de deux – recalling the intensity of MacMillan’s earlier Romeo and Juliet – that drive this tragic story, and make Manon one of MacMillan’s most powerful dramas.

În cel de-al cincilea episod al seriei „LA PAS PRIN PENITENCIARE”, ajungem în inima sistemului corecțional din jurul capitalei, trecând porțile a două dintre cele mai cunoscute și stricte unități din țară: Penitenciarul Rahova și Penitenciarul Jilava. O ediție profundă, încărcată de emoție și lecții dure de viață, care dincolo de ziduri și proceduri se oprește asupra poveștilor umane ce definesc realitatea din spatele gratiilor.

Veți urmări un interviu zguduitor și de o sinceritate brutală cu un deținut care a pierdut totul din cauza dependențelor. De la fraude ingenioase cu ordine de plată false și luxul aparent al unei vieți ghidate de adrenalină, până la o tentativă spectaculoasă (și aproape reușită) de a fugi în vacanță în Bulgaria chiar în momentul în care poliția îi percheziționa casa—această mărturie arată cât de ușor se poate trece de la libertate la un mandat de executare definitiv. Este povestea unui declin alimentat de droguri și jocuri de noroc, dar și a conștientizării dureroase că adevărata pedeapsă nu o ispășește cel încarcerat, ci familia care rămâne acasă.

În a doua parte a episodului, descoperim locul unde reconstrucția comportamentală devine posibilă în aceste unități: Comunitatea Terapeutică. Vizităm sala de mese comună—unde deținuții sunt obligați să mănânce împreună pentru a-și recăpăta spiritul de echipă—și spațiile speciale dotate cu plite și cuptoare, concepute pentru a-i ajuta să combată adicțiile și să rămână conectați la normalitatea mediului din care provin.

Un episod cu un contrast izbitor între haosul trecutului și disciplina necesară pentru un nou început în penitenciarele capitalei.

🔔 Abonează-te pentru a nu rata restul episoadelor din această serie documentară unică în România!

📍 În acest episod vizităm:

Penitenciarele Rahova și Jilava: O incursiune în realitatea zilnică a celor două unități masive de lângă București.

Mărturia din spatele gratiilor: Interviu exclusiv despre mecanismul fraudelor, fuga la frontieră și capcana dependenței de cocaină și adrenalină.

Consecințele haosului: Cum se transformă o viață fără țintă și cum se resimte trauma încarcerării asupra părinților și celor dragi.

Comunitatea Terapeutică: Zona specială unde deținuții își gătesc singuri și iau masa împreună, ca pas esențial în reabilitare și combaterea adicțiilor.

The Sleeping Beauty holds a special place in The Royal Ballet's repertory. It was the ballet with which the Company reopened the Royal Opera House in 1946 after World War II, announcing its move from Sadler's Wells to Covent Garden. Margot Fonteyn danced the role of the beautiful princess Aurora in the first performance, with Robert Helpmann as Prince Florimund. Sixty years later, in 2006, the original 1946 staging was revived, returning Oliver Messel's wonderful designs and glittering costumes to the stage once again.

Marius Petipa's classic 19th-century choreography is combined with newly created sections by Frederick Ashton, Anthony Dowell and Christopher Wheeldon. The ballet contains many memorable moments, from the iconic Rose Adagio, when Aurora meets her four royal suitors, to the vigorous hunting dances and the famous waltz for Aurora and her Prince. Throughout, Pyotr Il'yich Tchaikovsky's score conveys passion and intensity.

Principals of The Royal Ballet Yasmine Naghdi (Juliet) and Matthew Ball (Romeo) perform the passionate Balcony Pas de deux from Kenneth MacMillan's 20th-century ballet masterpiece.

Kenneth MacMillan's passionate choreography for Romeo and Juliet shows The Royal Ballet at its dramatic finest. Sergey Prokofiev's iconic score provides the basis for the ballet's romantic pas de deux and vibrant crowd scenes, while 16th-century Verona is created by Nicholas Georgiadis's magnificent designs.

In 1965, MacMillan's Romeo and Juliet was given its premiere at Covent Garden by The Royal Ballet and was an immediate success: the first night was met with rapturous applause, which lasted for 40 minutes, and an incredible 43 curtain calls. The title roles were danced by Rudolf Nureyev and Margot Fonteyn, although the ballet had been created on Christopher Gable and Lynn Seymour. It has been performed by The Royal Ballet more than four hundred times since, as well as touring the world, and has become a true classic of the 20th-century ballet repertory.

Yuhui Choe and Alexander Campbell dance Princess Florine and the Bluebird in Act III of The Sleeping Beauty, The Royal Ballet 2011/12. Find out more at http://www.roh.org.uk/sleepingbeauty

The Sleeping Beauty holds a special place in The Royal Ballet's repertory. It was the ballet with which the Company reopened the Royal Opera House in 1946 after World War II, announcing its move from Sadler's Wells to Covent Garden. Margot Fonteyn danced the role of the beautiful princess Aurora in the first performance, with Robert Helpmann as Prince Florimund. Sixty years later, in 2006, the original 1946 staging was revived, returning Oliver Messel's wonderful designs and glittering costumes to the stage once again.

Marius Petipa's classic 19th-century choreography is combined with newly created sections by Frederick Ashton, Anthony Dowell and Christopher Wheeldon. The ballet contains many memorable moments, from the iconic Rose Adagio, when Aurora meets her four royal suitors, to the vigorous hunting dances and the famous waltz for Aurora and her Prince. Throughout, Pyotr Il'yich Tchaikovsky's score conveys passion and intensity.

Royal Ballet Principals Edward Watson, Marianela Nuñez and Nehemiah Kish perform Frederick Ashton's Monotones II.

Find out more at http://www.roh.org.uk/productions/mon...

Frederick Ashton distilled the exquisite tranquility of Erik Satie’s pieces in Monotones I and II, which display some of his most modernist choreography. Monotones II was created first and given its premiere at the Royal Opera House in 1965, accompanied by Satie’s Trois Gymnopédies. Ashton created a second piece to Satie’s Trois Gnossiennes (Monotones I), and the two were presented together the following year. Satie’s Préludes d’Eginhard was played as an overture.

Monotones I opens with a slow, serene pas de trois in a wonderful example of adagio classicism. The dancers remain on stage throughout the entire work, with their smooth lines of movement unbroken. Monotones II features another pas de trois that mirrors the controlled movements of the first. Satie’s delicate music, coupled with Ashton’s beautiful choreography, is wonderfully haunting.

My name is Maegan Woodin, and I'm  a professional dancer, choreographer, teacher and student. I have danced for MTV, Diana Ross, Marc Jacobs and have appeared in many music videos. Pas de Bourree is a traveling step that moves back, side and front. And the position you should have with legs is you're going to have a coupe to the back with your foot pointed and both legs turned out. That's the start of your position in plie. And then, you're going to come to second position with your legs out and releve to the side. And then, you're going to cross forward and go back to that coupe position. So, demonstrating this Pas de Bourree, we're going to plie, back, step to the side and step back to the front. With your arms, you're going to have a simple arms out to the side. I'm going to demonstrate out to the side so you can concentrate on my legs. So, you're just going to turn out, side and back. And this step can also be moved but it's important not to travel the Pas de Bourree when you're in plie. You want to travel it on the releve step. So, traveling the Pas de Bourree, you're going to plie with knees out to the side. Your foot in coupe. And then, you're going to turn on the Bourree and come back to that position. So, demonstrating that from each corner. We're going to bend the knees and then, Pas de Bourree and land on the other side in coupe position. So, demonstrating it straight up. Front Pas de Bourree. Swan Lake was Tchaikovsky’s first score for ballet. Given its status today as arguably the best loved and most admired of all classical ballets, it is perhaps surprising that at its premiere in 1877 Swan Lake was poorly received. It is thanks to the 1895 production by Marius Petipa and Lev Ivanov that Swan Lake has become part of not only ballet consciousness but also wider popular culture. That success is secured not only by the sublime, symphonic sweep of Tchaikovsky’s score, but also by the striking choreographic contrasts between Petipa’s royal palace scenes and the lyric lakeside scenes created by Ivanov.

Swan Lake has had a special role in the repertory of The Royal Ballet since 1934. Since then there has been a succession of productions, the most recent of which was overseen by Anthony Dowell. This Season the Company creates a new production with additional choreography by Artist in Residence Liam Scarlett. Scarlett, while remaining faithful to the Petipa-Ivanov text, will bring fresh eyes to the staging of this classic ballet, in collaboration with his long-term designer John Macfarlane.

Jewels uses three gem stones as starting points to explore an array of musical and dance styles, each intimately connected to Balanchine’s own life and career. Sarah Lamb and Steven McRae perform the pas de deux from the 'Rubies' movement. Subscribe to our channel and find out more at roh.org.uk. 

George Balanchine’s glittering ballet Jewels was inspired by the beauty of the gem stones he saw in the New York store of jewellers Van Cleef & Arpels. He went on to make history with this, the first abstract three-act ballet, first performed in 1967 by New York City Ballet. Jewels was performed in full by The Royal Ballet for the first time in 2007, using costume designs from the original NYCB production and new set designs by Jean-Marc Puissant.

Each of the three movements draws on a different stone for its inspiration and a different composer for its sound. The French Romantic music of Fauré provides the impetus for the lyricism of ‘Emeralds’. The fire of ‘Rubies’ comes from Stravinsky and the jazz-age energy of New York. Grandeur and elegance complete the ballet in ‘Diamonds’, with the splendour of Imperial Russia and Tchaikovsky’s opulent Third Symphony. Through it all, Balanchine displays his genius for combining music with visionary choreography.

This simple animation video clearly explains the topics P-N junction semi conductor or diode, what is forward bias and reverse bias, what is diffusion current and drift current, what is avalanche breakdown etc

What is a P -- N junction semiconductor and how is it formed?

The PN junction semi conductor is a combination of P type semiconductor with N type semiconductor to achieve the practical utility of both. It's formed, when a P type semi conductor is joined to an N type semiconductor.
 
The P type semiconductor has free holes with positive charged and the N type semiconductor has free electrons with negatively charge.
 
What happens when a PN junction is made? 

When P and N semiconductors are joined to make the PN junction semiconductor diode, the electrons near the PN junction jump from N to P and holes near the junction jump from P to N. This phenomenon creates a space charge region or a depletion layer as shown in the video. At this space charge region due to the movement we have electrons in P region and holes in N region. For some time the electrons move back from P to N in the space region or depletion layer and some holes move back from N to P in the space region. This continues to happen till equilibrium is reached. This movement of electrons and holes in the space region or diffusion layer gives rise to Diffusion current. 

What is Forward bias and how does it occur?

Forward bias occurs when the positive terminal of battery is connected to the P region and the negative terminal of battery is connected to the N region. In this condition what happens is the positive terminal repels the holes towards the junction and the negative terminal repels the electrons towards the junction. Due to this repulsion, the depletion region or space region narrows down as shown in the video. 

But at a particular condition, If the voltage in the forward bias is above a specified range, the electrons in the N region drifts through the junction and migrates to the P region and the holes in the P region drifts through the junction and migrates to the N region. 

Now the current flows across the circuit and this current are called the Drift current. 

What is Reverse bias and how does it occur?

Reverse bias occurs when the negative terminal of the battery is connected with the N region and positive terminal with the P region. In this condition holes (positively charged) from the P region get attracted to the negative terminal of the battery and electrons (negatively charged) get attracted to the positive terminal of the battery. This results in the depletion layer to widen up. 

Now the PN junction acts as an insulator and will not allow any current to flow in the circuit. But at a condition, if the battery voltage is above a particular limit, which is called as the reverse bias breakdown voltage level. Electrons and the holes breakdown through the PN junction and cross over resulting in the current to flow through the circuit. This break down is called avalanche breakdown 

In this process the current flowing through the PN junction is very high and ultimately the PN junction gets damaged due to overheating caused by the excess flow of current. 
This is how a PN junction semiconductor works.

Paquita
Grand pas classique

In 1847, Paquita was staged for the first time in Russia for the Imperial Ballet of St. Petersburg by Marius Petipa and Pierre-Frédéric Malavergne, being the first work ever staged by Petipa in Russia. In 1881 Petipa produced a revival of the ballet for which he added new pieces specially composed by Ludwig Minkus. This included the Pas de trois (a.k.a. the Minkus Pas de trois or Paquita Pas de trois) for the first act, and the Paquita Grand pas classique and the Mazurka des enfants (Children's mazurka) for the last act. Petipa's version of Paquita was retained in the repertory of the Mariinsky Theatre until 1926.

Marius Petipa's 1881 additions for Paquita survived long after the full-length ballet left the stage. Today these pieces, particularly the Grand pas classique, are major cornerstones of the traditional classical ballet repertory and have been staged by ballet companies throughout the world.
In 2001, the choreographer Pierre Lacotte produced a revival of the full-length, two act Paquita for the Paris Opera Ballet. Although Lacotte re-choreographed all of the ballet himself, he restored Joseph Mazilier's original mime sequences and mise-en-scène, as well as Marius Petipa's 1881 additions.

P-N JUNCTION: When a p-type semiconductor is suitably joined to n-type semiconductor, the contact surface in called p-n junction. Consider two types of materials: One p-type and the other n-type as show in diagram. Left side material is a p-type semiconductor ‘having negative acceptor’ ions and positively changed holes. The right side material is n-type semiconductor having positive donor ions and free electrons. Suppose the two pieces are suitably treated to form PN junction. Keep in mind that n- type material has a high concentration of free electrons while p- type material has a high concentration of holes. Therefore, at the junction, there in a tendency for the free electrons to diffuse over to the p-side and holes to the n-side.
 As the free electrons move across the junction from n-type to p-type, positive donor ions are uncovered is they are robbed of free electrons, Hence, a positive charge is built on n-side of the junction. At the same time, the free electrons cross the junction and uncover the negative acceptor ions by filling in the holes. Therefore, a net negative charge in established on P-side of the junction. When a sufficient number of donor and acceptor ions is uncovered, further diffusion is prevented. It is because now positive charge on n-side repels holes to cross from p-type to n- type and negative charge on p-side repels free electron to enter from n-type to p-type. Thus, a barrier is set up against further movement of charge carrier, i.e. holes and electrons. This is called potential barrier or junction barrier v0 The layer name the p-n junction in which no free electrons or holes are available is called the depletion layer.

En France comme partout ailleurs, les abeilles disparaissent, parfois de manière dramatique. Or sans abeilles, ce n'est pas seulement le miel qui risque de manquer, mais aussi les fruits et les légumes.
Pour tenter de percer le mystère de la disparition des abeilles, Fred et Jamy se sont rendus dans le Vaucluse.
Fred est partie à la rencontre d'apiculteurs et d'agriculteurs.
Jamy, quand à lui a installé son mini labo à l'INRA d'Avignon au beau milieu des ruches destinées à la recherche.
Fred et Jamy partent récolter du miel chez un apiculteur et nous parlent du monde fascinant des abeilles. Nous verrons que ces hyménoptères ne manquent pas de travail. Chacune d'elles doit remplir ses multiples missions : tenir la ruche, nourrir les larves, produire de la cire, fabriquer les alvéoles, butiner, transporter le pollen, faire le miel...
Jamy nous expliquera qu'est-ce qui différencie les abeilles, des guêpes, des frelons et des bourdons, les fonctions des abeilles ouvrières, comment les abeilles fabriquent-elles du miel etc...

Tout d' abord , vérifiez les câbles
À l’ aide de la prise RJ45 de l’ ordinateur ou du port USB-C avec un dongle RJ45 ,
connectez un câble réseau Ethernet en bon état de fonctionnement
de votre ordinateur au port LAN de votre modem routeur
Assurez-vous que les deux extrémités du câble sont bien insérées

Eteignez le modem routeur et déconnectez son alimentation

Une fois terminé ,

P. I. Tchaikovsky
Marius Petipa, Lev Ivanov
Swan Lake

ACT III
Black Swan pas de deux

Odile.............................................Ekaterina Kondaurova
Siegfried........................................Timur Askerov

Mariinsky Ballet
2013

St. Petersburg, Russia

In this pas de deux, the black swan or Odile, Odette's pure opposite tries to entangle the prince to swear his love to her. She tries to convince him, that she herself is Odette. In truth she is actually Rothbart's (or Evil Genius as they like to call him in the Bolshoi) daughter, enchanted to look like Odette. The only difference is actually (beside her personality) her tutu, which is as you see black, unlike Odette's, which is white. 
In other aspects she is completely different from Odette. Unlike Odette, who embodies kindness, a kind of heavenly beauty and just a hint saddness and offcourse pureness, Odile is a living contrast to her. She is the living lust, passion and yearning, which lives in us all. She embodies the kind of darker part of not just the human psyche and soul, but is also the darker side  of Odette, that never existed. 
There is even a moment, in the pas de deux itself, when Siegfried for a second considers, if this is really Odette. And in most productions it is actually seen, that Odette is trying to warn through the windows, but he doesn't see her, because Odile is already there. 
Even in the coda and her variations we see, that she tries to entice not just the prince, but also the court, the court, the audience, the whole world. And good ballerinas are able to do jut that. They command the audience which their sheer presence on the stage, to look at them and only them. And this is certainly a job, which Kondaurova in my humble opinion certainly succeded in.

Now, if you are interested, here is a brief history on the entire pas de deux:

On 26 April 1877 the prima ballerina of the Moscow Imperial Bolshoi Theatre Anna Sobeshchanskaya made her début as Odette/Odile in Swan Lake, and from the start she was completely dissatisfied with the production of the ballet, but most of all with Reisinger's choreography and Tchaikovsky's music. Sobeshchanskaya travelled to St. Petersburg to have Marius Petipa—Premier Maître de Ballet of the St. Petersburg Imperial Theatres—choreograph a new pas de deux to replace the Pas de six that functioned as the third act's Grand Pas. For a ballerina to request a supplemental pas or variation was standard practice in 19th century ballet, and often these "custom-made" dances quite literally became the legal property of the ballerina they were composed for.
Petipa choreographed Sobeshchanskaya's pas de deux to music composed by Ludwig Minkus, who held the post of Ballet composer to the St Petersburg Imperial Theatres. The piece was a standard pas de deux classique that consisted of a short entrée, the grand adage, a variation for the dancer, a variation for the ballerina, and a coda.
Word of this change soon found its way to Tchaikovsky, who became very angry, stating that, whether the ballet is good or bad, he alone shall be held responsible for its music. He then agreed to compose a new pas de deux for the ballerina, but soon a problem arose: Sobeshchanskaya had no reservations about performing a pas to Tchaikovsky's new music, but she wanted to retain Petipa's choreography, and she had no wish to travel to St. Petersburg again to have the Ballet Master arrange a new pas for her. In light of this, Tchaikovsky agreed to compose a pas that would correspond to Minkus' music to such a degree that the ballerina would not even be required to rehearse. Sobeshchanskaya was so pleased with Tchaikovsky's new version of the Minkus music that she requested he compose for her an additional variation, which he did.
Until 1953 this pas de deux was thought to be lost, until an accidentally discovered repétiteur was found in the archives of the Moscow Bolshoi Theatre among the orchestral parts used for Alexander Gorsky's revival of Le Corsaire (Gorsky had included the piece in his version of Le Corsaire staged in 1912). In 1960 George Balanchine choreographed a pas de deux to this music for the Ballerina Violette Verdy, and the Danseur Conrad Ludlow under the title Tschaikovsky Pas de Deux, as it is still known and performed today.

Wright’s atmospheric and bewitching production of Marius Petipa’s Giselle will be performed at the Royal Opera House 14 February–20 March 2026. Book tickets now – https://www.rbo.org.uk/tickets-and-ev...  

Giselle is available to watch now – along with over 80 other extraordinary productions – on Royal Ballet and Opera Stream. Watch the whole performance now at https://www.rbo.org.uk/tickets-and-ev... 

Giselle is the classic ballet of the Romantic era. It transformed the dance world when it was first performed in Paris in 1841 and remains at the centre of the classical repertory. Giselle’s essence has remained the same through many different productions in well over a century of continuous performance. Peter Wright’s production for The Royal Ballet is based on Marius Petipa’s classic version (after the original 1841 choreography by Jules Perrot and Jean Coralli), which was first staged in St Petersburg in 1884.

The role of Giselle provides the dancer with many technical and dramatic challenges, from the character’s early love to her poignant descent into madness and her final gesture of forgiveness from beyond the grave. The first act of the ballet is filled with historical detail and rustic colour. By contrast, the second, ‘white’ act plunges the audience into an eerie moonlit forest haunted by the ethereal Wilis. With its combination of memorable story and exquisite choreography, Giselle is the perfect way to discover classical ballet.

After months of hard work, we crossed an important marker in the Ekonomi MADANI reform agenda. The implementation of BUDI MADANI RON95 (BUDI95) is the result of a carefully considered approach to subsidy targeting that balances the people's welfare with fiscal responsibility.

The reform is straightforward: ALL Malaysians continue to enjoy subsidized fuel at RM1.99 per liter - even lower than today's RM2.05. What changes is that non-citizens and corporate users pay market rate, ensuring subsidies reach those they were intended for.

This measured approach considered the best accessibility with seamless implementation across 4,000+ stations nationwide using MyKad verification. It considered sufficient allocation for 99% of Malaysians with 300-litres per month by crunching data from the Department of Statistics. The outcome from this is expected to be between RM2.5 to 4 billion annual savings that can be redirected to programs that benefit the rakyat.

The Government took time to ensure fairness in this reform. Rather than rushing into blanket price increases, or complicated targeted cash back assistance, we chose a path that protects Malaysian families while still addressing fiscal sustainability. The success of our diesel subsidy targeting - which exceeded savings projections from RM4 billion to over RM7 billion annually, demonstrates not only that we can do this with some clear-headed thinking, but that we must do this - to sustain our economic future. 

This is responsible governance in action. Every ringgit saved from better-targeted subsidies can support education, healthcare, infrastructure, and be directed towards assistance like STR and SARA programs. 

The phased rollout begins September 27 with our armed forces and the police, followed by STR recipients on September 28, and full implementation for all Malaysians on September 30.

BUDI95 represents another step toward sustainable growth built on sound fiscal foundations. When subsidies reach their intended recipients and government resources are optimized, we create space for the strategic investments Malaysia needs to achieve high-income status.

→ All Malaysians regardless of income can enjoy the new RM1.99/litre RON95 price starting 30 Sept. Users must have a MyKad with a functioning chip and an active driving licence.

→ Each user has a monthly limit of 300 litres of subsidised RON95.

→ E-hailing and p-hailing drivers can apply for a higher subsidised RON95 quota with supporting documents from their companies.

→ Government will monitor and flag abnormal refueling patterns. This is to prevent people from abusing the system by topping up repeatedly in a short time span and reselling fuel.

→ JPN is offering free replacements of damaged MyKad chips from 23 Sept-7 Oct. 

→ JPJ is extending weekend operating hours to 8.30am-4.30pm to handle driving licence and related services for the period 27 Sept-26 Oct.

→ RON95 will be sold at a subsidised price of RM2.05 per litre for eligible commercial vehicles and public transport vehicles including taxis, ambulances, school buses and food catering vans. Non-Malaysians and ineligible individuals will pay the unsubsidised market rate, to be determined at the end of September.

→ Foreign-registered vehicles cannot purchase RON95 and can only refuel with RON97.

→ Government expects to save between RM2.5 billion to RM4 billion annually under Budi95, depending on crude oil prices.

Let's talk about Malaysia's favourite alphabet soup: B40, M40, T20.

Here's the thing — a dual-income family in KL earning RM14,000, juggling a mortgage, two kids, ageing parents, and a car loan that feels like a second marriage… is officially "T20."

The framework has three quiet problems:

🔹 It's purely statistical. Being in the top 20% doesn't mean you can comfortably afford groceries — it just means 80% earn less than you.

🔹 It's geographically blind. RM8,000 in Kuala Lumpur ≠ RM8,000 in Kelantan. Yet the bracket treats them as twins.

🔹 It ignores wealth, debt, and dependents. A debt-free retiree and a sandwich-generation parent supporting 5 people sit in the same box.

A fairer path forward:
✅ A multi-dimensional index — factoring location, dependents, debt, and life stage 
✅ Graduated withdrawal instead of cliff-edge cut-offs 
✅ Redefine "wealthy" — the genuinely affluent are T5/T10, not the squeezed upper-middle 
✅ Update thresholds every 2 years, not every 5

The T20 label as shorthand for "can afford unsubsidised fuel" is lazy policymaking. Malaysians deserve a framework that reflects real lives — not just neat percentiles.

Because being classified as "rich" shouldn't feel like an inside joke.

The article discusses how the ongoing West Asia crisis (Middle East tensions) is impacting Malaysia’s economy, specifically regarding fuel subsidies. Malaysia is currently facing global instability that is driving up oil prices. This puts immense pressure on Malaysia’s fiscal position because the government spends roughly RM4 billion a month and RM48 billion annually on subsidies.

Because of that, the Government is reviewing the Budi MADANI RON95 (BUDI95) program, which is responsible for Government allocating approximately RM11 billion to cover the difference between the subsidised price of RM1.99 per litre and the unsubsidised pump price of around RM2.60 per litre. This is intended to ease the burden on citizens during the fuel crisis. The goal of the BUDI95 programme is to ensure financial aid reaches only those who truly need it while maintaining economic stability and long-term development.

Malaysia’s fuel subsidies helped cushion living costs for decades, but they also allowed structural inefficiencies to survive far longer than they should have.

Cheap fuel became a political tool as much as an economic policy. It reduced the urgency to improve public transport, strengthen supply chain efficiency, raise productivity, or address leakages and middle-layer inefficiencies in the economy.

Now, when subsidies are reduced, the real weakness becomes visible immediately — rising food prices, higher logistics costs, and pressure on ordinary households that still depend heavily on road transport.

The uncomfortable reality is that subsidies did not solve the problem. They merely delayed the need to fix it.

Peruntukan Wakil Rakyat Tidak Wajar Disekat, Lantikan Politik Bukan Hadiah Politik

Kuala Lumpur, 4 Jun 2026: Gabungan Pilihan Raya Bersih dan Adil (BERSIH) dan Institut Hal Ehwal Demokrasi dan Ekonomi (IDEAS) ingin menyatakan pendirian berhubung beberapa perkembangan terkini yang menyentuh aspek tadbir urus, kebertanggungjawaban dan amalan demokrasi di Malaysia. 

Kami berpandangan bahawa tindakan menyekat peruntukan kepada Ahli Parlimen tertentu serta ketiadaan akses yang konsisten kepada peruntukan pembangunan bagi Ahli Parlimen pembangkang menunjukkan bahawa usaha mewujudkan medan persaingan politik yang lebih adil dan saksama masih belum direalisasikan sepenuhnya.

Terbaharu, Ahli Parlimen Subang, YB Wong Chen dan Ahli Parlimen Petaling Jaya, YB Lee Chean Chung dilaporkan tidak lagi dapat mengakses laman sesawang Unit Penyelarasan Pelaksanaan (ICU) bagi memohon peruntukan pembangunan untuk kawasan masing-masing. 

Oleh itu, akses kepada peruntukan pembangunan tidak wajar ditentukan oleh perbezaan pendirian politik atau hubungan dengan pihak kerajaan. Peruntukan awam pada asasnya bertujuan untuk manfaat rakyat dan pembangunan kawasan, bukan sebagai instrumen ganjaran atau hukuman politik.

Kami juga ingin mengambil perhatian terhadap kenyataan Pengerusi DAP Johor, YB Teo Nie Ching, yang dilaporkan menyatakan bahawa pelantikan ke jawatan dalam syarikat berkaitan kerajaan (GLC) atau badan berkanun boleh dipertimbangkan untuk bekas ADUN Skudai sekiranya beliau tidak lagi memegang jawatan wakil rakyat selepas Pilihan Raya Negeri Johor akan datang.

Kami menegaskan bahawa pelantikan ke GLC dan badan berkanun perlu berasaskan merit, kelayakan dan keperluan institusi, bukan pertimbangan politik kepartian. Proses pelantikan yang tidak telus atau dilihat dipengaruhi politik boleh menjejaskan keyakinan awam terhadap integriti institusi. Kebimbangan ini disokong oleh dapatan penyelidikan IDEAS melalui inisiatif Pantau Kuasa dan laporan Who Sits at the Table: From Political to Public Appointees in Malaysia's Federal Statutory Bodies. 

Sehingga Oktober 2025, IDEAS merekodkan 238 pelantikan politik ke lembaga GLC dan badan berkanun persekutuan di bawah Kerajaan Madani. Laporan sama turut mendapati 78% jawatan pengerusi badan berkanun diisi individu berkait politik, selain ketiadaan kerangka perundangan yang menyeluruh dan piawaian kelayakan yang jelas. Ini meningkatkan risiko pertimbangan politik mengatasi merit, kepakaran dan kepentingan awam dalam pelantikan institusi penting. 

Sehubungan itu, kami menegaskan bahawa pelantikan ke GLC dan badan berkanun perlu dilaksanakan secara telus, berasaskan merit dan disertakan mekanisme semakan bebas. Jawatan GLC dan badan berkanun tidak wajar dijadikan pertaruhan atau hadiah sagu hati kepada mana-mana ahli politik yang kalah dalam pilihan raya. Amalan menjadikan jawatan tersebut sebagai ganjaran atau laluan politik adalah bertentangan dengan semangat reformasi tadbir urus serta mengukuhkan budaya penaungan politik.

Menjelang PRU-16, amat penting untuk semua parti dan ahli politik mendukung prinsip-prinsip demokrasi yang luhur. Dalam sebuah demokrasi yang matang, perbezaan prinsip dan fahaman politik tidak boleh dijadikan asas untuk mendiskriminasi mana-mana wakil rakyat atau menafikan hak rakyat yang diwakili mereka untuk mendapat manfaat daripada peruntukan awam. GLC atau badan berkanun juga tidak wajar dijadikan taruhan atau habuan kepada mana-mana ahli politik hanya kerana perubahan strategi atau menjaga kepentingan politik. Kepercayaan dan harapan rakyat terhadap institusi negara dan sistem politik yang kukuh dan matang tidak boleh diambil mudah.

PRN Johor, Negeri Sembilan - Wajarkah Parlimen Juga Dibubar Serentak?

Oleh Mynewshub 

KETIKA Johor sudah rasmi membubarkan Dewan Undangan Negeri (DUN) bagi memberi laluan kepada PRN dan Negeri Sembilan turut memasuki fasa persiapan politik yang semakin jelas, kembali timbul persoalan yang semakin kuat dibincangkan dalam kalangan penganalisis politik – adakah sudah tiba masanya kerajaan Persekutuan mempertimbangkan pembubaran Parlimen lebih awal untuk membolehkan pilihan raya diadakan secara serentak?

Cadangan itu bukan baharu, tetapi kini kembali mendapat perhatian susulan perkembangan politik semasa apabila beberapa negeri bergerak lebih awal daripada jadual asal. 

Pembubaran awal Parlimen sepatutnya dilakukan memandangkan kerajaan Madani adalah kerajaan campuran pilihan ahli politik dan bukannya rakyat.

Penyokong BN tidak pernah mengundi calon-calon PH pada pilihanraya umum ke-15 lalu dan begitu juga sebaliknya.

Masing-masing membenci satu sama lain.

Tiba-tiba selepas pilihanraya, pemimpin kedua parti membentuk kerajaan dan membedak atau membahagikan jawatan kabinet sesama sendiri.

Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim menjadi Perdana Menteri walaupun perikatan parti beliau hanya menerima 82 kerusi Parlimen, jangan kata dua pertiga, majoriti mudah pun gagal dicapai.

Atas hakikat ini, kita boleh katakan bahawa kerajaan yang ada bukan kerajaan yang majoriti rakyat pilih, maka PRU16 seharusnya diadakan pada kadar segera.

Jangan beri alasan seperti perlu tumpu tadbir negara. Tadbir negara memang perlu dibuat sampai bila-bila pun, tidak ada tempoh di mana pentadbiran negara boleh dihentikan untuk sebarang tujuan.

Malah, melaksanakan PRU adalah satu amalan demokrasi yang sihat.

Penganalisis melihat penyelarasan pilihan raya boleh mengurangkan kos logistik, jentera pilihan raya, pengurusan petugas serta perbelanjaan operasi kerajaan. 

Suruhanjaya Pilihan Raya (SPR) sebelum ini turut menyatakan bahawa pilihan raya yang dijalankan serentak berpotensi menjimatkan kos keseluruhan proses demokrasi negara. 

Di Johor, pembubaran DUN diumumkan dengan alasan memberi mandat baharu kepada rakyat dan memastikan kestabilan pentadbiran negeri. 

Dalam masa sama, perkembangan di Negeri Sembilan menunjukkan negeri itu juga tidak menolak kemungkinan melalui proses pilihan raya lebih awal bergantung kepada pertimbangan semasa kerajaan negeri. 

Penyokong idea penyelarasan pilihan raya berhujah bahawa rakyat kini berdepan situasi hampir berterusan keluar mengundi – daripada PRN ke PRK dan seterusnya PRU – yang turut memberi kesan kepada tumpuan pentadbiran serta aktiviti ekonomi.

Namun begitu, terdapat juga pandangan berbeza yang menegaskan bahawa pembubaran Parlimen adalah keputusan besar dan tidak semestinya perlu diselaraskan dengan pilihan raya negeri kerana mandat kerajaan Persekutuan masih berkuat kuasa sehingga tamat tempoh penggal.

Apa pun pendiriannya, perkembangan terkini di Johor dan Negeri Sembilan dijangka menjadi petunjuk penting kepada landskap politik negara menjelang pilihan raya umum akan datang.

Persoalannya kini — adakah rakyat mahukan satu pusingan pilihan raya serentak, atau mengekalkan kitaran pilihan raya berasingan seperti sekarang? 

Sudah semestinya rakyat mahu hak mereka memilih kerajaan dikembalikan, dan bukan ditentukan oleh ahli politik yang berbincang sesama mereka untuk membentuk kerajaan. -MYNEWSHUB

Kecoh Konvensyen PKR Johor bila Naib Presiden PKR, R Ramanan disanggah secara terbuka oleh Hassan Karim, Ahli Parlimen Pasir Gudang.

Sebabnya ialah R Ramanan menggunakan pentas konvensyen parti untuk menyerang saya. 

Saya tak rasa apa pun. Serangan terhadap saya yang diatur bertali arus ini akan memakan diri. Jadi lagi banyak Ramanan buka mulut, sebenarnya lagi bagus.

Saya juga ucap terima kasih kepada Saudara Hassan Karim. Masih ada lagi beberapa orang dalam PKR sekarang yang faham tentang adab, jasa, sumbangan, perjuangan dan pengorbanan.

Rakyat menonton sendiri bongkaknya Ramanan sehingga boleh menasihati secara terbuka seorang Perdana Menteri supaya jangan salah pilih menteri ekonomi. Maknanya, sebelum ini Perdana Menteri telah buat silap kerana memilih saya menjadi Menteri Ekonomi.

Dia mungkin rasa itu cuit manja dia dengan Anwar Ibrahim, tetapi orang ramai boleh menilai bahawa adab kebiasaannya bukan begitu. Ramanan berkelakuan demikian kerana dia cukup yakin pengaruhnya dengan Anwar Ibrahim.

Dan saya menjadi saksi kepada semua itu.

Di hari-hari terakhir sebelum pengumuman calon untuk PRU15, hanya tinggal satu kerusi yang tidak ada persetujuan antara saya dengan Dato’ Seri Anwar - iaitu Sungai Buloh.

Saya tetap dengan pendirian bahawa antara dua nama iaitu Sivarasa Rasiah (penyandang ketika itu) dan Ramanan, Sivarasa adalah calon yang lebih baik dari segala aspek.

Lagi pun Ramanan berkeras pada ketika itu tidak mahu mengisytiharkan harta, sedangkan calon-calon lain telah menghantar pengisytiharan harta.

Keadaan ini berlanjutan hingga ke hari pengumuman calon dan tidak selesai sehingga jam 6 petang, sedangkan majlis akan bermula jam 8 malam.

Dalam bilik Dato’ Seri Anwar di Bukit Gasing pada ketika itu, ada saya, Anwar Ibrahim dan seorang teman rapat kami. Seboleh yang mungkin, bila berjumpa dengan Dato’ Seri Anwar dari dulu-dulu lagi, saya mahukan ada saksi supaya ceritanya tidak bertukar di kemudian hari.

Maka kejadian ini ada saksi. Saksi itu cukup rapat dengan saya dan Anwar Ibrahim.

Saya tetap tidak berganjak dan menyatakan keputusan Jawatankuasa Calon bahawa Sivarasa adalah calon yang lebih sesuai dari segenap aspek.

Akhirnya, Dato’ Seri Anwar, dalam keadaan kami sama-sama duduk, memegang lutut saya dan merayu untuk lepaskan Ramanan jadi calon.

Saya lihat matanya ada genangan air mata.

Jadi saya sebut kepada beliau: 

“You ada the final say. I’ve done everything I can, tapi kalau you berkeras, that’s your decision. You don’t have to plead macam ni”

Jawapan Dato’ Seri Anwar:

“Saya tak mahulah nanti you buat kecoh”

Saya jawab balik:

“Akhirnya it’s your decision. Saya hanya minta Dato’ Seri janji that this is as far as Ramanan will go in PKR and politics. You will not appoint him further in the party and kalau menang jadi kerajaan, you will not appoint him into the government.”

Dato’ Seri Anwar nampak lega dan bersetuju dengan janji-janji itu.

Malam itu, oleh kerana keputusan hanya dicapai di saat akhir, bila nama Ramanan diumumkan sebagai calon PKR di Sungai Buloh, gambarnya masih gambar Sivarasa. 

Sebab kami tak sempat tukar gambar Ramanan di saat akhir.

Selepas jadi kerajaan, walaupun semasa pembentukan kerajaan Ramanan tidak dilantik, bila ada saja rombakan pertama Ramanan terus dilantik menjadi Timbalan Menteri.

Itu sekitar akhir 2023. 

Jadi pada ketika itu pun saya tahu, ada hubungan istimewa di antara Dato’ Seri Anwar dengan Ramanan, sehingga Perdana Menteri sanggup melanggar janjinya sendiri kepada saya yang disaksikan oleh seorang lagi rakan baik kami berdua.

Saya juga telah sedar pun pada ketika itu bahawa banyak perkara yang kita mulanya ingat tidak menjadi titik perbezaan - contohnya soal Azam Baki, SPRM dan lain-lain - akan terus bermasalah, kerana cerita-cerita mengenai Farhash, Ramanan dan lain-lain mula kedengaran.

Kalau saya kongsi perkara ini sebelum Konvensyen PKR Johor, orang tidak percaya.

Sekarang, saya harap orang ramai boleh nilai sendiri bahawa Dato’ Seri Anwar sudah terikat dengan beberapa orang seperti Ramanan ini.

MCA President Wee Ka Siong recently said in a media interview that he did not sign a statutory declaration to support PAS President Abdul Hadi Awang as Prime Minister. This is sophistry, his cunning deception.

The SD that Wee signed was to support Muhyiddin Yassin, who was then Chairman of Perikatan Nasional, in establishing a federal government with Bersatu and PAS.

In the 19 November 2022 general election, Pakatan Harapan won 82 parliamentary seats nationwide (71 in Peninsular Malaysia), Perikatan Nasional won 74 seats (71 in the Peninsula), while Barisan Nasional secured 30 seats (23 in the Peninsula). No coalition obtained a simple majority of 112 seats.

At that point of time, Wee Ka Siong’s SD was signed to support the formation of a Perikatan Nasional government with Muhyiddin as Prime Minister.

Wee’s reasons for signing the SD were:

1. He believed the situation at the time was chaotic.
2. He adhered to the idea of “no Anwar, no DAP”, and therefore, supported Perikatan Nasional in forming the government.

If the next general election, be it in 2026 or 2027, once again sees a three-cornered fight between Pakatan Harapan, Barisan Nasional, and Perikatan Nasional, we may again see that no single coalition secures a simple majority. 

We can also be fairly certain that if history repeats, Wee Ka Siong would probably once again support Perikatan Nasional to form the government.

Wee is among the strongest advocates within Barisan Nasional for a three-cornered contest in the next general election. This is because he believes a three-way contest would allow MCA to contest more seats, not just confined to their two incumbent seats.

Since this MCA President has chosen to bring up this issue, and given that he is one of the strongest proponents of a three-cornered fight, he has to make clear to the voters whether he will support the now PAS-dominated Perikatan Nasional in forming the government should the political situation of 2022 recurs.

At least by being honest, voters can know what MCA stands for.
If you trust Wee Ka Siong, pig will climb tree.

"PAS WAS FURIOUS UNTIL THEIR EMERGENCY MEETING. WHAT HAPPENED?"

BY LOKMAN ADAM

The emergency PAS meeting ended exactly the way many expected. All smoke, no fire. After days of dramatic warnings against Bersatu, PAS leaders suddenly went silent after gathering their top leadership behind closed doors. Malaysians were left staring at political theatre without a conclusion.

This is the problem with PAS today. The party wants to sound fierce in public but cautious in reality. They openly accuse Bersatu of betrayal, arrogance and breaking promises, yet when the moment arrives to make a hard decision, PAS retreats into silence.

That is not strength. That is political hesitation.

PAS president Abdul Hadi Awang already laid out serious accusations against Bersatu. He claimed Bersatu blocked coalition expansion, ignored agreements and damaged the spirit of cooperation within Perikatan Nasional. The Perlis Menteri Besar controversy was even cited as proof of Bersatu’s bad faith.

If those accusations are true, why is PAS still dragging its feet?

A political party that truly believes its partner is toxic should not need endless meetings and indefinite reviews. It should act decisively. Instead, PAS now looks trapped inside a relationship it no longer trusts but is too afraid to abandon.

Bersatu, meanwhile, continues behaving like a party obsessed with control and dominance. Since the beginning, Bersatu’s political style has revolved around leverage, pressure and survival tactics. The coalition was never built on mutual respect. It was built on temporary convenience and electoral desperation.

That is why PAS and Bersatu increasingly resemble toxic twins. One weaponises religious and emotional narratives while the other masters political manoeuvring and power games. Their partnership was stitched together by ambition, not sincerity.

Now both sides are exposing each other publicly. PAS complains Bersatu cannot be trusted. Bersatu sees PAS as dependent but unwilling to leave. The coalition no longer projects confidence. It projects suspicion, insecurity and internal decay.

The biggest loser in all this confusion is Perikatan Nasional itself. Elections are approaching fast, yet its own leaders cannot even provide clarity about whether the coalition still has genuine unity. Voters are expected to trust leaders who clearly no longer trust each other.

What happened after the PAS special meeting says everything. Loud accusations before the meeting. Deafening silence after the meeting. PAS wants the political mileage of attacking Bersatu without carrying the courage and consequences of making a final decision. That is not leadership. That is political limbo dressed up as strategy.
